skill.name: opencontext
skill.description: Persistent memory and context management for AI agents using OpenContext. It helps teams store project decisions, search prior context, and reuse knowledge across sessions.
skill.summary: Store, search, and reuse OpenContext memory across AI coding sessions.
skill.author: supercent-io

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks, reference links, and documented local paths. The real risks are persistent storage of project context, user-level agent configuration changes, and third-party CLI execution. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or covert network calls.

remediation.issue: User-level agent configuration may be modified during initialization.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit approval before running initialization or changing user command, skill, MCP, or AGENTS.md files.

remediation.issue: OpenContext can retain sensitive project context across sessions.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users not to store secrets or regulated data, and document cleanup, export, and delete workflows.

remediation.issue: The workflow depends on a third-party CLI and command execution.
remediation.suggestion: Pin package versions, verify the publisher, and review command output before running CLI actions.

remediation.issue: Embedding configuration may involve API keys and external providers.
remediation.suggestion: Use secure secret storage for real keys and clearly document which embedding endpoints receive data.

static_findings.snippet: | `/opencontext-help` | When you don't know where to start |
| `--mode keyword` | Keyword-based search | No embeddings required |
| `--mode vector` | Vector search | Embeddings + index required |
| Cite document | Click the citation icon next to the document title | Agent reads the full document

semantic_findings.title: Persistent Project Context Storage
semantic_findings.description: The skill directs agents to preserve project background, decisions, and lessons in a local OpenContext store and database. This can retain sensitive project data across sessions if users store secrets or regulated information.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The stated workflow is to keep context across sessions and store conclusions in documented local storage. The risk is data retention, not hidden exfiltration.

semantic_findings.title: User-Level Agent Configuration Changes
semantic_findings.description: The skill says initialization generates user-level commands, skills, MCP configuration, and updates AGENTS.md. These changes can affect future agent behavior and should require explicit user approval.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file explicitly describes generated user-level agent assets and MCP config paths. This is a clear configuration-change risk even though it is disclosed.

semantic_findings.title: Third-Party CLI Installation and Execution
semantic_findings.description: The skill instructs users to install or invoke the OpenContext CLI and run commands such as initialization, indexing, and UI startup. This creates supply-chain and command execution risk if performed automatically.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The commands are explicitly documented and appear legitimate, but package installation and command execution should not be automatic for a community skill.

content.user_title: Manage AI Project Memory with OpenContext
content.value_statement: AI agents lose project context between sessions, causing repeated explanations and stale assumptions. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to store, search, and reuse OpenContext knowledge.
actual_capabilities: Explains how to install and initialize the OpenContext CLI in a project.
Documents slash commands for loading, searching, creating, and updating context.
Shows folder, document, search, manifest, index, and link workflows.
Lists OpenContext MCP tools for folders, documents, search, manifests, and stable links.
Provides daily workflows for recording decisions, pitfalls, and next steps.
Describes desktop and web UI workflows for citations and context management.
limitations: Requires the OpenContext CLI, desktop app, or MCP integration to be installed separately.
Semantic search requires an embeddings API key and a built index.
Stored context quality depends on user curation and regular updates.
Does not verify third-party commands, package integrity, or secret handling automatically.

use_cases.title: Resume Project Work
use_cases.description: Load prior architecture notes, decisions, and pitfalls before changing code.

use_cases.title: Share Agent Research
use_cases.description: Store analysis findings so other agents can reuse the same project knowledge.

use_cases.title: Maintain Project Memory
use_cases.description: Record acceptance criteria, API contracts, and dependency decisions after each work session.

prompt_templates.title: Load Project Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Use OpenContext to load the most relevant background for this repository. Summarize decisions, pitfalls, and next steps before coding.

prompt_templates.title: Search Prior Decisions
prompt_templates.scenario: Find existing knowledge before making a change
prompt_templates.prompt: Search OpenContext for previous decisions about this feature. Return the most relevant notes, citations, and unresolved questions.

prompt_templates.title: Store Session Conclusions
prompt_templates.prompt: Create or update an OpenContext document with session decisions, files changed, tests run, risks, and recommended follow-up work.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Multi-Agent Research
prompt_templates.prompt: Use OpenContext as the shared memory layer. Load existing context, assign research topics, merge findings, and store final conclusions with citations.

output_examples.input: Load context before implementing a payment API change.
output_examples.output: The agent summarizes stored API contracts, prior payment decisions, known pitfalls, and documents that should be read first.

output_examples.input: Search for previous lessons about flaky integration tests.
output_examples.output: The agent returns matching notes, relevant folders, document titles, and a short explanation of each result.
The agent records the final design choice, validation steps, unresolved risks, and next actions in project memory.

best_practices: Load OpenContext before starting work that depends on prior decisions.
Store concise conclusions with citations, dates, and clear next steps.
Review context before reuse and remove outdated or sensitive information.
anti_patterns: Do not store credentials, tokens, private keys, or regulated personal data.
Do not run initialization commands without reviewing the files they may modify.
Do not rely on stale context when source files or requirements have changed.

faq.question: What does this skill help an AI agent remember?
faq.answer: It helps record project background, decisions, pitfalls, API contracts, and follow-up work in OpenContext.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Do I need the OpenContext CLI?
faq.answer: Yes, CLI workflows require the OpenContext command-line tool or compatible MCP and desktop integrations.

faq.question: Can it search stored documents?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes keyword, vector, and hybrid search modes for stored OpenContext documents.

faq.question: Where is context stored?
faq.answer: The skill documents a local OpenContext store and SQLite database under the user home directory.

faq.question: What should I avoid storing?
faq.answer: Avoid storing secrets, credentials, regulated data, and information that should not persist across sessions.
